title: Module 16 quiz — Interview simulator
description: Eight questions on maturity levels, modes, and BayPay interview method.

questions.prompt: How many questions are in the AEJE interview bank, and may you add a 101st?
choices: 50; yes if they are harder
Exactly 100 with locked domain counts; do not add a 101st
Unlimited; the simulator generates more
16; one per module
questions.explanation: Spec §25 and COURSE_MANIFEST.json lock the bank at 100.

questions.prompt: What is wrong with one memorized paragraph for every seniority?
choices: Nothing; shorter is always better
Engineer / Senior / Staff / Principal must show different scope and trade-offs
Principal answers must be longer than 2,000 words
Staff answers must name a live AWS account
questions.explanation: Maturity is the product. The bank stores four answer layers.

choices: A complete system-design whiteboard
Short, correct-enough answers under time — not Staff-depth on every item
A proven RCA with no evidence
A Terraform apply in us-west-2

questions.prompt: In a troubleshooting interview, a lucky correct RCA with no method should…
choices: Max Diagnostic method because the title matched
Not max Diagnostic method — quotes and next-gate thinking are required
Automatically fail Technical accuracy
Require bouncing dmgr-east

questions.prompt: Which lab produces the system-design portfolio artifact?
choices: INTERVIEW-1602
INTERVIEW-1604 (PF-design.md)
Q-16 only

questions.prompt: Is the BayLearn interview UI required to pass Module 16?
choices: Yes; otherwise the bank is invalid
No; Phase A is paper plus interview-bank/simulator.py
Yes; and you must call Bedrock
Yes; you must enroll in Interview Accelerator
questions.explanation: Phase B is additive. Do not reuse Interview Accelerator.

questions.prompt: A Staff answer about ECS vs EKS should…
choices: Say AWS is the only correct platform
Name when Fargate wins, when EKS wins, and when OpenShift stays — for BayPay this quarter
Require applying EKS in a 90-minute lab
Recommend ND-in-Docker
Only rapid fire
More than one mode in one sitting (practice/timed, troubleshooting, and a design slice)
A live WebSphere cell
A force-push to main
questions.explanation: The loop is the product, not a single trivia item.
